description: Defines the interface and binder classes for the DRM Manager service in Android, including method signatures for DRM operations such as rights management, decryption, and session handling.

classes.name: IDrmManagerService
classes.description: Interface class for DRM Manager service, declaring DRM-related methods.

classes.name: BpDrmManagerService
classes.description: Binder proxy class for IDrmManagerService, implementing method calls.

classes.name: BnDrmManagerService
classes.description: Binder stub class for IDrmManagerService, handling incoming transactions.

methods.name: addUniqueId
methods.description: Adds a unique DRM session ID, indicating if native.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Registers a client with a specific unique ID.

methods.name: setDrmServiceListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for DRM service events.

methods.name: canHandle
methods.description: Checks if content can be handled by DRM.

methods.name: getOriginalMimeType
methods.description: Gets the original MIME type of content.

methods.name: setPlaybackStatus
methods.description: Sets playback status for DRM content.

methods.name: openConvertSession
methods.description: Opens a DRM data conversion session.

methods.name: closeConvertSession
methods.description: Closes a DRM data conversion session.

methods.name: pread
methods.description: Reads data from a decrypted stream.
